## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] New or changed parts are in the gallery tests and the parts table in `SKILL.md`
- [ ] README images redrawn with `python3 examples/gen_examples.py` if they are affected, and checked by eye
- [ ] Entry added under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` if the skill or parts library changed
- [ ] `python3 tests/test_api.py --update` run if a public signature changed on purpose
- [ ] No confidential content in images or examples
